detail.build_truncated: Build instructions are incomplete. Review the full files before continuing.
window.title: {page} — braurser
discover.title: Find something useful
search.empty_body: Try a different name or remove a filter.
search.start_body: Search by name or by what you want to do.
filter.title: Filters
filter.orphans_help: Installed as helpers and no longer required or optionally used by other installed packages. You may still use them yourself.
filter.foreign_note: For installed software, this includes packages outside official repositories—not only community builds from the AUR.
filter.requires_installed: This filter applies to installed software.
source.community_help: Build instructions shared by an AUR contributor, not an official distribution package.
source.git_help: Installed from a Git repository using a script you approved.
source.outside_help: This launcher is not managed by braurser.
source.foreign_help: Not found in your current official repositories. Its original source has not been confirmed.
detail.no_description: No description is available for this software.
detail.no_dependencies: No additional helper software is needed.
detail.build_mutable: These instructions may download other files that can change independently.
detail.build_unavailable: Build instructions could not be loaded. Try again before continuing.
community.title: Community build information
community.notice: Community builds use instructions supplied by contributors. They can run commands on your computer. Review the instructions and only install software whose source you trust.
community.context: Community activity is context, not a security check.
community.popularity_help: An AUR activity measure based on votes and their age. It does not measure security or quality.
community.orphan_notice: This build has no listed maintainer. Updates and fixes may be delayed.
community.outdated_notice: Someone has reported that this build is out of date.
wiki.title: Arch Wiki
wiki.attribution: From the ArchWiki, GNU FDL 1.3 or later
wiki.empty_body: There isn’t a linked article for this software.
wiki.error: The article couldn’t be loaded. You can try again or open ArchWiki in your browser.
wiki.offline_uncached: This article hasn’t been saved. Connect to the internet to read it.
wiki.distro_note: ArchWiki describes Arch Linux. Some instructions may differ on {distribution}.
variant.title: Which version of {app}?
variant.body: Choose how you want to receive this app.
variant.official_body: A stable version provided by your distribution.
variant.binary_body: Already built. Usually faster to install.
variant.source_body: Built from source during installation. This can take longer and use more storage.
variant.git_body: Includes recent changes that may not be fully tested. It may be less reliable than a stable release.
variant.appimage_body: Uses an AppImage bundle. It may include its own copies of helper software.
variant.nightly_body: An automatically produced development build. It may contain unfinished changes.
variant.beta_body: A version being tested before a stable release. Some features may not work as expected.
variant.reason_official: Recommended because a stable version is available from your distribution.
variant.reason_binary: Recommended because this stable version does not need to be built on your computer.
variant.reason_source: Recommended because this is the available stable source-built version.
variant.reason_appimage: Recommended because this is the available stable version.
variant.no_stable: Only development or preview versions are available. Choose one to continue.
variant.different_sites: These versions list different project websites.
variant.stable_body: The stable edition of this app.
variant.wayland_body: A build intended for Wayland desktops.
confirm.build_ack: I have reviewed the build instructions.
confirm.remove_body: The app will no longer be available.
confirm.remove_component_body: This software will no longer be available.
confirm.remove_dependents_ack: I also want to remove the listed apps that need this software.
confirm.remove_helpers: {count, plural, one {Remove # unused helper} other {Remove # unused helpers}}
confirm.keep_files: Personal files and app settings will be kept.
confirm.files_unknown: This software’s removal instructions may change other files. Review them before continuing.
confirm.protected: {package} is needed to keep this system usable. braurser won’t remove it.
confirm.plan_changed: The required changes have changed. Review the updated list before continuing.
confirm.queue_note: Another operation is running. This will wait until it finishes.
confirm.git_untracked_removal: This installation has no supported removal method. braurser can’t remove it safely.
activity.log_warning: Logs may include local paths and account names. Review them before sharing.
activity.empty_body: Installations, removals, and updates will appear here.
activity.partial_changes: Some changes were completed before the operation stopped. Review the details before trying again.
activity.changes_unknown: The final state couldn’t be confirmed. Refresh installed software before trying again.
activity.cancel_pending: Cancellation requested. Waiting for a safe stopping point.
activity.cannot_cancel: This step can’t be interrupted while system files are being changed.
activity.close_body: braurser can keep working in the background. Open braurser again to see its progress.
updates.system_first: Update system first, then update this app.
updates.current_body: No updates were found at the last check.
updates.logout: Needs you to log out and back in
updates.unknown_note: Some restart effects could not be determined.
updates.news_ack: I have completed the steps in this notice.
updates.news_block: Read and acknowledge the required notices before updating.
updates.news_unavailable: Update notices couldn’t be checked. A recent notice may describe steps needed before updating.
updates.news_unavailable_ack: I understand that required update instructions may be missing.
updates.reason_group: These packages must be updated together: {packages}.
updates.reason_system: This update is part of a required system transition.
updates.reason_backend: The update tool can’t postpone this package independently.
updates.reason_unknown: The required relationships could not be determined.
restart.title: Restart to finish updating
restart.confirm_body: Open apps will close. Save your work before continuing.
restart.blocked: Another app is preventing a restart. Save your work and use your desktop’s restart command.
restart.failed: The restart couldn’t be requested. Use your desktop’s restart command.
restart.logout_title: Log out and back in to finish updating
restart.logout_body: Save your work, then sign out using your desktop’s session menu.
restart.apps_body: Close and reopen these apps when you have saved your work: {apps}.
restart.unknown_body: If updated software behaves unexpectedly, save your work and restart your computer.
notification.updates_body: {count, plural, one {# update is ready to review in braurser.} other {# updates are ready to review in braurser.}}
notification.restart_body: Save your work, then open braurser when you’re ready to restart.
notification.attention_body: Open braurser to review the next step.
git.url_help: Use an HTTPS link to a Git repository.
git.url_invalid: Enter a valid HTTPS Git repository URL.
git.credentials_rejected: Remove the username, password, or access token from this link.
git.fetch_failed: The repository couldn’t be read. Check the link and your connection.
git.redirect_title: This link points to another host
git.redirect_body: The repository redirects from {original_host} to {destination_host}. Continue only if you expect this.
git.other_files: Other files and commands used by this script
git.risk: This script can change files your account can access. Only continue if you trust its source and understand what it does.
git.external_risk: This script may download or run other code. The commit shown here does not fix the contents of those external sources.
git.review_ack: I have reviewed this script and want to run it.
git.no_script: No supported install script was found in this repository.
git.unsupported: braurser can’t install this repository automatically.
git.script_too_large: This script is too large to review here. braurser won’t run it without a complete review.
git.changed: The selected script changed. Review the new commit and script before installing.
git.user_body: braurser won’t ask for an administrator password. Other people using this computer won’t see this installation.
git.system_body: Available to all users. Requires administrator permission.
git.system_risk: Administrator access lets this script change the whole computer.
git.scope_unavailable: This script doesn’t support this installation option.
git.launcher_result: Find it in your app launcher as “{launcher_name}”.
git.no_launcher: Installation finished, but no app launcher entry was created.
git.installed_system: Installed for everyone on this computer.
git.cleanup_unknown: Some files may have been left behind. Review the details before trying again.
installed.outside_notice: We didn’t install this; we can’t remove it safely.
installed.outside_help: These launcher entries aren’t owned by your package manager or tracked by braurser. This list may not include all software installed elsewhere.
installed.empty_apps_body: Browse Discover to find apps available for your computer.
installed.empty_components_body: Try changing your search or filters.
installed.empty_git_body: Apps installed with a Git link will appear here.
installed.empty_outside_body: All detected launcher entries are already accounted for.
installed.open_failed: {app} couldn’t be opened. Try opening it from your desktop’s app launcher.
installed.launcher_missing: No app launcher entry is available for this software.
settings.helper_busy: Wait for the current operation to finish before changing helpers.
settings.autostart_help: Runs braurser’s update checker when you sign in.
settings.cache_body: Cached downloads, pictures, and articles will be removed. Installed software won’t change.
settings.cache_offline: Removed downloads and articles won’t be available offline.
settings.cache_busy: Files needed by current or queued operations will be kept.
settings.cache_failed: Some cached files couldn’t be removed. Files still in use were kept.
settings.save_failed: This setting couldn’t be saved. Its previous value has been restored.
auth.title: braurser needs administrator permission
auth.install: To install {app} for everyone on this computer.
auth.update: To install the updates you approved.
auth.setup: To install the software needed for community builds.
auth.git: To run the install script you approved for everyone on this computer.
auth.context: Only enter your password if you just approved this action in braurser.
auth.incorrect: That password wasn’t accepted. Try again.
auth.denied: This account isn’t allowed to approve this action.
auth.failed: Authentication couldn’t be completed. Try again.
auth.timeout: The authentication request expired. Continue the operation to try again.
auth.canceled: Authentication canceled. No administrator action was started.
auth.native_wait: Approve the request in your desktop’s authentication window.
auth.unavailable_body: braurser couldn’t open a desktop authentication prompt or its local password dialog. You can still browse software.
auth.fallback_notice: No desktop authentication prompt was found. braurser will use its local administrator password dialog.
first.title: Welcome to braurser
first.body: Find, install, and update software for your computer.
first.official_ready: Official software is ready to browse.
first.helper_body: Community builds need an extra tool.
setup.title: Set up community builds
setup.body: braurser uses paru or yay to prepare community builds. Choose a helper to review its installation.
setup.build_notice: The helper will be built from community instructions. Review those instructions before installing.
setup.failed: Community-build setup couldn’t be completed. Official software is still available.
setup.unsupported: Automatic helper setup isn’t available on this system.
setup.auth_help: Install and start a polkit authentication agent for your desktop or window manager. Restart braurser after it is running.
offline.title: You’re offline
offline.cached: Showing saved information from {date}. Installation needs a connection.
offline.local_ready: Saved information is available. Actions that can be completed locally are still available.
offline.empty: Connect to the internet to browse available software. Installed software is still available.
offline.update: Connect to the internet to check for updates.
offline.operation_block: This operation needs files that aren’t saved on this computer.
error.repositories_body: Check your connection and repository settings, then try again.
error.lock_title: Another software tool is making changes
error.lock_body: Wait for it to finish, then try again. Don’t delete the package-manager lock file.
error.storage_body: This operation needs {required_size}, but only {available_size} is available at {location}.
error.build_tools_body: Review and install the required helper software before building this package.
error.package_missing: This software is no longer available from the selected source.
error.integrity_body: braurser stopped before using these files. Refresh the available software and try again.
error.build_body: The build instructions didn’t finish successfully. Review the log or try a different available version.
error.core_title: braurser lost contact with its software service
error.core_body: The operation’s final state is not yet known. Reconnect before starting another operation.
error.unsupported_title: This action isn’t supported on this system
error.unsupported_body: You can still browse software and inspect what is installed.
error.generic_body: Review the details, then try again.
